license.title: Commercial use
license.intro: Want to sell or commercially use work made with this product? Request a commercial license for your type of use.
license.ctaHint: The store reviews each request first; you pay only after approval. Files are not included and are bought separately.
license.formIntro: For {product}. Fill in every field; the store will review it and post the result on My licenses.
license.notOffered: This product does not offer a commercial license right now.
license.usageHint: Pick one or more. The total is the sum of every type you pick.
license.contactHint: For example a phone number, LINE ID or social link
license.artistHint: Who made the work that uses this product. If it is the buyer, enter the same details.
license.platformHint: For example Etsy, Shopee, YouTube, a publisher
license.artworkHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 5 MB. Only the store can see it.
license.noteHint: For example print run or how long it will be used
license.submitHint: No payment yet. The price is locked at this total; if approved you can pay by QR.
